provenance: Kittaneh's 1991 nilpotent Schatten lemma and its explicit quasinilpotent extension question are combined with the standard diagonal formulas for unilateral weighted shifts. Monotone weights tending arbitrarily slowly to zero give compact quasinilpotent shifts whose self-commutator is trace class while the shift misses every finite Schatten class.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The finite-nilpotent implication and standard weighted-shift self-commutator formulas are prior art. The claimed contribution is the explicit negative resolution of Kittaneh's finite-p quasinilpotent extension question by a single compact weighted shift. Older weighted-shift, almost-normal-operator, and operator-ideal literature was not exhaustively checked theorem by theorem, so an unadvertised equivalent observation remains possible.
